title: Indirect questions 1
note: ROUGH STUB 2026-09-01. Do you know where the station is? Statement order after know / tell me. No backshift. Not if/whether as the whole unit. B1 pack stays. Sort correct / needs repair. Use = correct. · F9 2026-09-03 (James smoke): was the thinnest A2 grammar pack — quiz 7 vs a median of 20. +7 quiz, +2 sort pairs, still word-order-only and no backshift. Fills the gaps: did-insertion in the past (absent before), who / why / what + does, how long, and the Could you tell me / Do you remember openers. sort_rule added.

items.en: Do you know where the station is?
Do you know where is the station?
I don't know what time it is.
I don't know what time is it.
Can you tell me how much this is?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik to stojí?

items.en: Can you tell me how much is this?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik to stojí?

items.en: Do you know where she went?
Do you know where did she go?
Do you know who that woman is?
Do you know who is that woman?
Do you know where the station is?
accepts: Do you know where the station is?
items.wrong: Do you know where is the station?
items.explanation: After **know**: **where the station is** — statement order. Not *where is*.
items.explanation_cz: Po **know**: **where the station is**. Ne *where is*.

items.en: I don't know where he lives.
accepts: I don't know where he lives.
I do not know where he lives.
items.wrong: I don't know where does he live.

items.en: Can you tell me what time it is?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik je hodin?
items.gap: Can you tell me what time ____?
accepts: Can you tell me what time it is?
items.wrong: Can you tell me what time is it?

items.en: Do you know how much this costs?
accepts: Do you know how much this costs?
items.wrong: Do you know how much does this cost?

items.en: She asked where the toilet is.
accepts: She asked where the toilet is.
items.wrong: She asked where is the toilet.
items.explanation: Keep **is** (no backshift). Order: **where the toilet is**.

items.en: I don't know when the shop opens.
accepts: I don't know when the shop opens.
I do not know when the shop opens.
items.wrong: I don't know when does the shop open.

items.en: Do you know if she is at home?
accepts: Do you know if she is at home?
items.wrong: Do you know if is she at home?
items.explanation: After **if**: **she is at home**. Not *is she*.
items.explanation_cz: Po **if**: **she is at home**. Ne *is she*.

items.en: Do you know who that woman is?
accepts: Do you know who that woman is?
items.wrong: Do you know who is that woman?
items.explanation: After **who**: **that woman is** — statement order. Not *who is that woman*.
items.explanation_cz: Po **who**: **that woman is**. Ne *who is that woman*.

items.en: I don't know why she is late.
accepts: I don't know why she is late.
I do not know why she is late.
items.wrong: I don't know why is she late.
items.explanation: **why she is late** — the subject comes before **is**.
items.explanation_cz: **why she is late** — podmět je před **is**.

items.en: Can you tell me what this word means?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, co to slovo znamená?
accepts: Can you tell me what this word means?
items.wrong: Can you tell me what does this word mean?

items.en: Do you know where she went?
accepts: Do you know where she went?
items.wrong: Do you know where did she go?
items.explanation: **where she went** — no **did** inside. The past is already in **went**.
items.explanation_cz: **where she went** — uvnitř žádné **did**. Minulost je už ve **went**.

items.en: Could you tell me how long the film is?
items.cz: Mohl byste mi říct, jak dlouhý je ten film?
items.gap: Could you tell me how long ____?
accepts: Could you tell me how long the film is?
items.wrong: Could you tell me how long is the film?
items.explanation: **how long the film is**. Not *how long is the film*.
items.explanation_cz: **how long the film is**. Ne *how long is the film*.

items.en: I don't know if he works here.
accepts: I don't know if he works here.
I do not know if he works here.
items.wrong: I don't know if does he work here.

items.en: Do you remember what he said?
accepts: Do you remember what he said?
items.wrong: Do you remember what did he say?

cards.title: Indirect questions
points: A normal question: **Where is the station?**
After **Do you know** / **I don't know**, the inside is a statement.
**where the station is** — not *where is the station*.

rows: Do you know where the station **is**?
I don't know what time it **is**.

cards.title: Not Czech order
points: Czech keeps question order inside: *kde je nádraží*. English does not.

rows: *Do you know where is the station?*
Do you know where the station **is**?
*I don't know what time is it.*
I don't know what time it **is**.

sort_rule: Inside the question, keep statement order: subject, then verb. No does, no did, and no swapping.
